messages:
carmen: canary for billing-service just reported DB migration error on init job, 1/3 canary pods failing w/ migration timeout.
deploy-bot: Canary health check failed: migration-job billing-migrate-2026-03-21 returned exit 1. Stopping further canary promotions per policy. Auto-rollback eligible: true.
leo: what migration? schema v20260321-add_invoices index creation timed out against read-replica.
oncall-db: confirmed long lock on replicas, looks like connection storm from canary workers triggered a slow DDL.
maya: if this is only on read-replicas we could try routing migrations to primary only and finish, but that breaks canary isolation.
release-manager: options: 1) rollback to previous chart+image immediately; 2) patch migration to skip long index creation and retry; 3) manually run migration on primary then retry canary. Need quick call.
carmen: leaning rollback to be safe. We can't risk partial schema applied.
leo: +1 rollback. Also capture debug logs and keep the failing revision around for forensic.
sre: if we rollback, ensure we pin previous chart revision and image digest so deploy-bot doesn't attempt re-promote the same broken artifact.
maya: I can run rollback and pin. Command set:
```
helm rollback billing-service 4 --namespace prod
helm upgrade billing-service ./charts/billing \
  --set image.digest=sha256:deadbeef --reuse-values
kubectl annotate helmrelease billing-service \
  release.redwood.io/rollback-reason="migration-failed-canary" --overwrite
```
deploy-bot: initiating automated rollback window. Creating incident ticket: canary-migration-fail-1761245678. Rolling back to revision 4.
carmen: capture current release metadata first: `kubectl get helmrelease billing-service -o yaml > /tmp/billing-rev5.yaml`
leo: doing that now. Also grabbing migration job pod logs: `kubectl logs billing-migrate-2026-03-21 -n prod`
oncall-db: will check replica lag and locks, posting findings in thread.
sre: after rollback completes, recommend blocking automated promotions for this chart until postmortem and runbook update. Add flag: `release.redwood.io/promotion-block=true`.
release-manager: noted. I'll update release notes: "Rollback performed after canary DB migration failure; previous stable revision restored. Investigation ongoing. Do not re-promote revision 5 until clearance."
maya: rollback in progress, pods terminating.
deploy-bot: rollback to revision 4 successful. New pods at 100% ready. Canary state: paused.
carmen: verifying client-facing endpoints, smoke tests OK.
oncall-db: replica locks cleared after rollback. Primary shows migration unfinished; we'll coordinate offline on safe migration strategy.
leo: created follow-up issue RDW-489 to repro migration in staging with higher concurrency, propose adding a migration timeout/retry and index creation with CONCURRENT if DB supports it.
release-manager: agreed. Scheduling postmortem and runbook updates for tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Also adding note to changelog for v1.8.1: rollback due to migration flakiness.
sre: re-enabled promotion gating after manual approval flag is cleared. To re-enable: `kubectl annotate helmrelease billing-service release.redwood.io/promotion-block=false` and then re-run canary in maintenance window.
carmen: thanks everyone. Please add any debug artifacts to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: incident closed for active rollback. To reopen or rerun canary use `deploy-bot rerun --chart billing --rev 5 --canary` after `promotion-block` cleared.
